instruction: Make the smallest necessary change to learner.overview so a learner can distinguish the early numeral form 亖 from the current/later graph 四 and understand the actual competing explanations. Keep the supported present form outer 囗 enclosing inner 儿-form strokes clearly modern/visible only. State that early forms written 亖 are described as directly representing four and coexisted with forms written 四; do not collapse those graphs. Identify the four-counting-rod reading as an interpretation of some 四 forms, separate from the呬 and泗 borrowing proposals. Make explicit that one proposal treats 四 as an earlier breath-related graph linked to 呬 and borrowed for four, without establishing the depicted referent’s ancient name; another proposes 四 was the original graph for 泗 (“nasal discharge”) later borrowed for four, and the book says that proposal lacks textual attestation. The expert formation/history already preserves this detail; preserve all other article claims, fields, evidence and structure.
verified_review_findings: Latest factual review requires the learner account to state explicitly that the distinct 泗 proposal treats 四 as the original graph for 泗, depicting nasal discharge, later borrowed for four; keep the lack of textual attestation in the expert account. The expert account already has this detail; the learner overview currently only says “a graph later borrowed for four.”

Latest readability review proposes adding a modern Mandarin 儿 ér / 四 sì comparison to components[1].sound. Independently assess that demand: the component is deliberately classified with unknown ancient role, IDS evidence only establishes present layout ⿴囗儿, and no dossier evidence establishes an ancient phonetic role or a cited 儿 reading comparison. Do not add an uncited/unnecessary sound role based only on modern readings; preserve current structure as visual identity and keep its ancient role unknown.

Round-3 independent readability verification separately required the counting-rod interpretation be identified as a proposal, rather than making it sound like the established direct writing of four. Independently check this against the cited evidence: the book’s distinct Shang form 亖 is directly used for the numeral, while the counting-rod reading is a separate interpretation of some 四 forms.
editorial_adjudication: Separate current shape, early numeral form, and competing analyses. Official CNS evidence X-741838c69c6335267eb0 identifies current IDS ⿴囗儿 and explicitly does not establish the ancient identities or roles of those shapes. 字源 evidence X-e6d62080b1a5fc5178a4 distinguishes Shang 亖 directly used for the numeral from later and coexisting 四 forms, then reports the distinct 泗 proposal and says it lacks textual attestation. Separate secondary evidence X-2723cf5f9190c41c2cfe and X-4b62255296f832195814 report the breath/呬 account and system-specific sound comparison; the proposed referent’s ancient name and pronunciation remain unknown. Sinica X-7b17032f87fb77433387 reports the separate four-counting-rod interpretation and also lists competing explanations. Do not merge the three hypotheses or convert the graphic reading into a certainty.
citation_correction_instructions: Use X-741838c69c6335267eb0 for the present ⿴囗儿 identity only; X-e6d62080b1a5fc5178a4 for the separate early 亖 and 泗/lack-of-text-attestation claim; X-7b17032f87fb77433387 for the counting-rod interpretation; and X-2723cf5f9190c41c2cfe / X-4b62255296f832195814 for the attributed breath/呬 proposal. Cite through evidence_ids, not inline source labels.
source_followup_questions: Does the learner overview distinguish the early direct-numeral form 亖 from four-counting-rod interpretation(s) of 四 forms and from the separate 呬/breath and 泗/nasal-discharge proposals?
Does the text accurately scope the breath/呬 referent as unidentified by ancient name, while reserving lack of textual attestation specifically for the 泗 proposal?
Are modern 囗 and 儿-form strokes explained as current visible structure only, separate from historical redraws and ancient component roles?
source_followup_policy: Earlier reviewer findings and this adjudication are hypotheses for independent factual checking, not verdict instructions. Correct actual omissions and retain supported scoped claims; do not add a phonetic role to an unknown current visual component based only on a modern reading resemblance.
